name: Midwest Plastics Inc.
about:
Midwest Plastics Inc., a family-owned manufacturer, was founded in 1945 and operates from a 48,000-square-foot facility in West St. Paul, Minnesota. The company has remained under family ownership since its inception, serving customers with custom and standard plastic products.

The company provides injection molding, thermoforming, and packaging services. Injection molding produces electronic housings, machine parts, gears, consumer products, medical components, hardware, and houseware items. Thermoforming capabilities cover machine covers, shrouds, blisters, clamshells, CRT bezels, printed-circuit-board storage trays, medical trays, automotive and aerospace components, and point-of-purchase displays. Packaging services include radio-frequency and heat sealing, boxing, labeling, collating, assembly, sorting, and shipping. The facility also supports prototype development for thermoformed parts.

Midwest Plastics serves the medical, automotive, aerospace, defense, energy, and telecommunications sectors. Its customer base includes the Department of Defense, the Department of Energy, and manufacturers of medical devices, electronic equipment, and consumer goods. The company also produces a line of consumer organizers, kitchen utensil drawers, garbage bag dispensers, and cutting boards sold directly through its website.

The company emphasizes end-to-end service from concept through design, manufacturing, warehousing, and distribution. Engineers review product designs and advise on material selection, focusing on quality design and cost-effective tooling. Trained operators run efficient equipment, while in-house quality-control personnel conduct frequent inspections to ensure consistency. Packaging receives special attention to meet specific customer requirements.
